# GreenInvest Pakistan issue forms

Use these structured forms to report a reproducible product problem or suggest
a clearer public explanation. Sensitive vulnerabilities belong in
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/mbax0009/GreenInvest-Pakistan/security/advisories/new),
not a public issue.

Never attach electricity bills, addresses, account numbers, private quotations,
saved plans, access tokens, or screenshots containing personal information.
